notes.title: Update 1.39
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Preparing the groundwork for the campaign missions gave many opportunities to optimize and correct the code (or even discover or create new bugs).  Most of, if not to say all, enemy animations were "recoded" to avoid possible conflicts at some point.
In addition to allowing entry to the lab and browsing the campaign map (now available as a tease factor), analysing this update under the microscope will reveal a bunch of optimization and tweaks.

So without further delay, let's get the details out a bit. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39320023/7f137f8d546a05e7f1c6c4fc13355b86bcb2714f.png
Version 1.39:


Tweaks section:
[olist]
 Added dynamic eye animations to the characters in the scenes.
 Reworked the start menu, and other sub menu buttons with a new holographic design to align with the coming campaign style.
 Reworked the player labels in game to be clearer.
 Reworked the game tutorial by adding frames into presented sections. Also adjusted a message concerning the score penalty if an enemy flees the level.
 Explosions from liquid-pocketed projectiles are brighter.
 Bonus salty and sugary crystals captured in the bloodstream have new and distinct sounds.
 Point values were adjusted for some special enemies appearing in the game play. 
 Optimize audio to avoid overlapping in some conditions.
 Reworked all enemy animations to avoid possible conflicting process.
 The weaker Botulinum bacteria (mothers) will not leave the area anymore in the 4th challenge level (Botulinum nest).
 Reduced the energy cost of electric discharge and adjusted upward by 20% for each additional unlock of the same type (Bait, sonic mine or electrical discharge).
 White blood cells will get blurry if hit by the nanobot instrumental weapons. 
[/olist]


Bug squish section:
[olist]
 Using the pause menu to return to the main menu during a challenge level could make the game hang and crash or avoid the challenge level.
 Using the cancel button on the option scene caused the game to stop.
 Salmonella bacteria reaching the artery exit could also cause a game crash.
 A 2 players game could also cause a crash if either nanobot was out of service and reached the artery exit from the bloodstream while Salmonella bacteria was present in the level.
[/olist]


New Stuff section:
[olist]
 The campaign map is available for browsing (not playable), maybe you can find an anticipation surprise there somewhere :)
 A new RED Label penalty can be witnessed at the organism health and player score labels if any enemy flees from the level. A specific sound and message will also be appearing.
 A new label (keeping count of fled enemies) may appear in the 1st and 2nd challenge levels if an enemy has left the area. 
[/olist]


This sums it up for now.

Thank you for protecting the organism with your nanobot. I wish you a lot of fun :)

Hello everyone,

A small temporary theme is present for this time of year and this one can bring its share of thematic treats in the gameplay. Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.37
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your patience concerning the delay in updates lately. I worked hard on many fronts to prepare the future updates.
Naturally the campaign work began as well as some competitive game modes, graphics development, some coding and design activities.

Regarding the creation of content for the campaign, the whole adventure should revolve around 50 missions. This number is not final, but ideas and development are now targeted towards this goal.

A short summary video should appear during the next few weeks to show you the work accomplished.

But for now, let's savor the details of this update. 


Version 1.37:


Tweaks section:
1- Some labels were changed in the option scene to accommodate a section for the new control mode.

2- Also the information bubbles concerning the COVID-19 virus or other organic enemies now specify a better scoring when these are activated.

3- Changed the order of the explanations in the tutorial.


Bug squish section: 
1-Initiating "pause" mode could cause a crash in the tutorial. This bug is now fixed.


New stuff section:
1- Surely now you can play the game with the mouse.
Controlling the Nanobot with this tool was tricky, but I am now satisfied with the result. A degree of precision will be necessary in the adventures of the campaign and I wanted the possibility of using the mouse to be present (especially if you do not have a gamepad).
By reaching the option scene and enabling or disabling mouse control you will be able to take advantage of this controller for player 1.
Please take note, that enabling mouse aiming will dominate control priorities for the game.

2- Added more generic Halloween items to some game menus for a seasonal wink has been updated.



This sums it up for now.

As always, I thank you for your support and enjoy the game :)

notes.title: Update 1.35
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39320023/a401c5827083e7b482db3a2d0646815492b4982d.png

Hello everyone

Finally the update 1.35 is available.

The main direction of the current game mode is to get a fun and replayable arcade game that can be enjoyed by learning some fun facts about the world of microorganisms and the immune system. There will be a few more updates for this game mode, and then I'll get into campaign development.

The development framework, design and future programming periods will reduce the frequency of updates. However, this development will bring more significant updates for the future, and during that time you will have a robust arcade game to enjoy.

At the moment, adding three new enemies with their own design, mechanics, strengths and weaknesses and implementing them in the game required a lot more development than expected. But the results are very positive.

Before I move on to the technical notes, I would like to welcome the new nano pilots, but most importantly, I want to thank you for your interest in the game.
It is really appreciated.  


Here are the technical details of this update.

Version 1.35:


Tweaks section:
Antibiotics and subsonic mines damage were adjusted to be more effective.
New particles effects were added to the vitamins and vaccine components.
Adjusted the cost of electric discharge to be less demanding.
Adjusted the speedy nano bullets to not exit via the artery.
Adjusted the white blood cell angle of attack and skipping animation when moving toward a target.

Bug squish section:
Corrected the animation of the white blood cell receiving genetic or vaccine code while it was out of service.
Corrected the delivery of genetic material to the white blood cell not being accounted for.
Corrected the Pallidum bacteria not leaving correctly if using artery exit.
Corrected the basic math method which was randomly giving a false number of bacteria left in the scene.

New Stuff section:
Salmonella bacteria, Escherichia coli (E.coli) and the Flu virus (Influenza) may appear after reaching level 5.
All enemy types (Tetani, Salmonella, E.coli, et virus influenza) will permanently constitute the 15th level and beyond. 
A new challenge by reaching the 20th level presenting a new strain of Salmonella is available.
New fun facts concerning the new Salmonella, E.coli, and Influenza virus are also implemented in the game.



This sums it up for now.

Thank you for protecting the organism with your nanobot. I wish you a lot of fun :)

notes.content:
Hello everyone,

5 controller profiles for all, and in the organism ... take advantage of it :)

But first, let's enjoy this time of year that I couldn't pass up without hanging some decorations.

As usual, this temporary little theme will be in the gameplay with the possibility of discovering some specific sugar candies as well as a themed music party.

I hope you enjoy it as much as I do.

Version 1.34 also brings its level of changes and optimizations as well as some new stuff. 

Without further delay, lets unwrap this update and enjoy the details.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39320023/e28fac875aae7e653dacdeaf31efa5a7e017daf4.png

Version 1.34 recap video:
[previewyoutube=yU5TvjJj7MQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Tweaks section:
[olist]
 To correctly represent the vaccine, it was important to gain a certain level of detection for the immune system.  The vaccine will now grant the usual reaction bonus (ADV) to the immune system, but will also grant a detection toward one of the special enemies in the detection matrix (KCMB).

 The calculated damage to the organism from the special enemies has been modified and the table below represents the various dangers (or damage) respectively by type.

Klebsiella minor = 10
Mutation = 15
Pallidum = 20
Klebsiella major = 25
Botulinum = 30

The navigation in various menu scene (while using a gamepad) can now be done with the d-pad or left joystick.
[/olist]

[/olist]

[/olist]



This sums it up for now.

I take the opportunity to wish you a happy holiday season and a new year 2022 filled with health, generosity and kindness.

Thank you for protecting the organism with your nanobot. I wish you a lot of fun :)

Working with the organism's immune system is not always tangible, but this little update will clearly confirm your aid.

notes.title: Update 1.32
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Many changes and addition makes this update an important one.

The antibiotic and vaccine components are now present in the game, but also a new event, new sound additions, adjustments and many more stuff. 

So lets get in the details right away.
  


Version 1.32:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39320023/933dd3198511411c25eba057ffb3b98ea9843cce.png


Tweaks section:

- Modified the center area for messages during gameplay to avoid stretching toward screen borders.
- Adjusted the spawning of usable genetic material by defeating special enemies to a ratio of 30%. 



Bug squish section:

- Modified a level where the mutation would get stuck between organism walls.
- Added a new message area in the GUI to avoid overlapping texts.
- Corrected a method concerning the nutrients and the red blood cells leaving the level incorrectly. 



New Stuff section:

 - Vaccine component is making its appearance.  For the time being, it will mainly boost the immune system (White blood cells) during the gameplay. In the future it will be used to gain a certain level of detection toward special or unknown enemies.  Nanobot can help by collecting the vaccine and delivering it to a white blood cell. Since all white blood cells are part of the immune system, the benefit of the vaccine will spread, and they will gain either a better detection range, better damage or simply better speed toward known targets. 

 - Antibiotic components are also coming to the bloodstream. This type of drug is worthwhile against bacteria, but is useless against viruses and can even damage the white blood cells. Its dissolution aura can be triggered by collisions from various sources, so be wary when you plan to use it.  

 - A new event is also coming with this update : The party!
This event will produce cocktail alcohol molecules in the bloodstream. These components can defeat a white blood cell in an encounter, but can also diminish the white blood cells present in the bloodstream for as long as alcohol lingers around.  Unhealthy, for sure, but its up to your skills to diminish its bad effect and get the white blood cells back into play. 
 
 - Many new sounds and texts are also in the gameplay. The main idea for this requirement was to associate a sound with an event as the gameplay might be intense at some point and reading the texts to understand what is going on, is not fun. 

- Sugars, salts, cholesterol, alcohol, vitamin, medicine (vaccine + antibiotic), genetic material and special enemies have their distinct spawning sounds now.

 - Two new information scenes are now included. They are randomly chosen before your statistics and present some fun facts about the new vaccine and antibiotic components. 



This sums it up for now.
Thank you for protecting the organism with your nanobot. I wish you a lot of fun :)

notes.title: Update 1.31
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The road map changed a little, I talked previously about the vaccine, but before bringing the modern medicine into play, I wanted to get the fluctuating blood composition into the game. So this update will add some cool new events related to that subject.
(Not to worry, the modern medicine is coming soon to the game: vaccine and antibiotic).

As the player protects the organism from the Tetani bacteria infection, bonus or challenges levels gets the nanobot into a timed challenge. This change of pace is required at the game core, but in the normal gameplay, breaking the cycle of the tedious Tetani infection required difficult enemies, vitamins or BONUS salty components to appear.  
Therefore, based on inspirational medical facts from the adapting immune system, new events are coming to the game also.
This will allow the nanobot to participate in the evolution of the immune system, prevent cholesterol clog in the exit artery and capture BONUS sugar components.

So without further delay, let's get into the details of this update.


Version 1.31:


Tweaks section:
Some minor changes in the spawning method of other enemies.
Corrections in some option labels.


Bug squish section:
No bug were squished for now.


New Stuff section:
1- A new detection molecule can spawn from defeating special or difficult enemies (Klebsiella, Botulinum, Covid, or Mutation enemies). There is a 50% chance that this unstable component will appear allowing the player to catch and deliver it to a white blood cell. This feature allows the adapting immune system to learn as new menaces appear in the bloodstream and provide detection and defense throughout the game.

2- The bloodstream may contain concentrated nutrients floating around, and keeping a healthy organism requires a nano action.  Nanobot can capture the NEW sugary concentrated components to avoid medical problems.  This action will grant a generous bonus score to every component caught.

3- Cholesterol or High level of LDL Cholesterol (Low Density Lipoprotein) can have an impact on health. Getting this theory in action for the game was amusing.  If the LDL cholesterol reaches the artery exit, it may create a clog and prevent the red blood cells to reach the artery exit, thus preventing regeneration of the organism. 

4- To be consistent with the added items, a set of three new information scenes relevant to the adapting immune system, sugar and cholesterol can now appear.



This sums it up for now, as always, I thank you for your support and enjoy the game :)

notes.title: Update 1.29
notes.content:
Hello nanopilots,

We all enjoy floating around and defeating tetani bacteria, but this little update will set the pace for a new fun factor.
In fact, an event may occur and give you the possibility to act upon it, or just keep your focus on the main goal, which is defeating the organic menaces and keeping the organism healthy.

This update will also, and finally, bring a short "tutorial/dynamic explanations" scene to the game and the demo.

ok, let's get into more details concerning the update 1.29

Version 1.29:


Tweaks section:
New methods bringing more diversity, flexibility and randomness as well as a better control of some elements in the bloodstream. Those methods are now in effect for the red cells, the white cells and the nutrients.
Some graphic tweaks on the interface and the main background.


Bug squish section:
A miscalculation occurred in the challenge scoring scene, which is now corrected.


New Stuff section:
-New short tutorial : A short tutorial/dynamic explanation is offered at the first round of play.  You can bypass it and go straight to the level or read the classic instructions as well, since there is a cute little scene presenting you those options now.

-New vitamins : Considering some important nutrients for the organism, it was time to introduce the Water-soluble and fat-soluble vitamins. Those may appear in the bloodstream from time to time. Capturing them will accelerate the dissolution and provide an immediate effect on the present game level.

-New salty component: Eventually, the bloodstream may contain concentrated nutrients floating around. Your nanobot can detect them and help the dilution and prevent future complication for the organism.  As a game perspective, you have the chance to gather more score if you capture them.

-New labels were introduced to witness the scoring from the vitamins or salty components. 


This sums it up for now, as always, I thank you for your support and enjoy the game :)

notes.title: Update 1.28

Hello everyone,

welcome to the new players who discovered the game during the steam summer sale and encouraged its development.

Without further delay lets dive into this small update.

New animation and new methods to spawn red cells and other elements from the artery entrances. This immersive tweak adds a little more decor cells floating around in the bloodstream and may catch your gaze.  

In fact, you will definitely detect the streams of red blood cells in the level (Yes, you did before, but now it is better), thus helping you trace back the source of needed hormones to replenish your nanobot.

As you may be grateful for that matter now, you will appreciate it much more in the future as new components will be added to the stream. (Surprise, surprise, shhh... did somebody say the word "vaci..."?)

New Stuff section:

notes.title: Update 1.26
notes.content:
Hello nanobot pilot,

The days became weeks but update 1.26 is here.

What happened to update 1.25 ?
A minor bug in 1.25 got me unsatisfied, and I knew I would rework some code in update 1.26 anyway, so I postpone the release of 1.25.

So here is update 1.26 ! 

I hope you enjoy :) 


Version 1.26:
The new scoring methods are here and will contribute largely to the future updates and development of the game. Thus completing the 2nd part of the refurbished scoring section previously announced.

Introducing the 1st and surely not the last, of coming challenges for the current gameplay.
New scenes, new challenge level, new music, and new bonus score. And YES, all playable in coop.


Tweaks section:
-Maximum of spawning Tetani is fixed for the 20th year and beyond. You can (with luck) get over this huge milestone and continue for your best score (of all time).

-More generous "bonus" score depending on your weapon efficiency. The more you hit those pesky virus or bacteria and the more you avoid any hits on the organism, the better your bonus will be.

-More points if you activated the COVID-19 menace or other possible dangers, even better results if you defeated any of them. Now represented on score scene after each level (game year).

-Speaking of points, let me remind you, that if you ever want to test your skills, choosing a harder difficulty level also raises the points earned.

-And more points if you complete the level with speed since nanobot is based on defeating the organic menace on a certain time frame. Can you surpass the basic "nanobotic" efficiency and the engineer's predictions ? 


Bug squish section:
-Corrected the miscalculation of damage to the organism with the subsonic mines
-Corrected the stutter effect coming from certain particles during game session.
-Corrected the shaded method after the instruction scene page:2
-Corrected performance of loading scenes.
-Corrected the energy discharge to better acknowledge enemies in the area of discharge.
-Corrected the capture of blue hormones though the nanobot was out of service.


New Stuff section:
New challenge level to face each time the player reaches a milestone of 5 levels (5-10-15-20-25...) (1 challenge for now, but many more coming).
New challenge bonus score added to the player's score by completing the challenge level.


This sums it up for now, as always, I thank you for your support and enjoy the game.

notes.title: Update 1.24 - Scoring and information scenes - 1st phase.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I want to thank the new owners of the game that took advantage of the Steam "remote play together" event.
Your interests, suggestions, comments and feedback about the game are always welcome. The steam forum is a nice cooperative board, or you can also, reach me on twitter via @arcadeessence.

Depending on every day life management, I will read and reply or exchange with you guys.


So enough of the "chit chat bla bla" !
Where is the game going to ? 

This main goal is to get the game into full arcade survival fun.

Which requires:
1- New scoring methods.
2- Some new animations or info scenes between levels.
3- Challenges or boss like levels.
4- World leader board and achievements. (I just keep pushing this further down the road, but it will be worth it at the end) 


Version 1.24: - Scoring and information scenes - 1st phase.

Tweaks section:
None for this update


Bug squish section:
Corrected a glitch of certain labels on start of level.


New Stuff section:
To get the actual game mode on track for arcade fun, I implemented the scoring for each player on the main scene.
You can track your score while playing and not solely depend on the level completion to witness your success.

The scoring is also being "refurbished".
New methods are slowly getting into the game to acknowledge scoring and calculating bonuses at the level completion. More development is coming this way for that matter.

Speaking of the level completion, from now on, when you reach the artery exit with a success, an informative scene will display before the final scoring scene. The information shown will be of various nature; enemies, general information, human biology, gameplay hints, etc.
There are seven (7) little information scenes that will appear in a random order, for now, but much more will be coming soon.


This sums it up for now, as always, I thank you for your support and enjoy the game :)

notes.title: Update 1.23
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I have been working on some new stuff and some bug squishing, so I merged all changes into a more complete update and reached 1.23. 

What is 1.23 ?
Below is a list with some explanations of all tweaks, bugs, and development included in this update.


Tweaks section :

1- Changed the Bait duration from 60 seconds to 30 seconds.
	-To lower the wait time of a new launch since only one bait can be launched at a time.
	-To avoid the waste of a longer dissolution time without Tetani bacteria to attract,



 
Bug squish section :

1- Parallax background paused for a short time lapse.
	-Depending on direction of bloodstream, some layers paused every now and then for a second.

2- Crashing of the game in a specific situation where the mutation was reaching the artery exit with bullets/hormones attached.




New Stuff section :

1- A visual effect to witness some damage.
	Most weapons the nanobot uses can also harm the organism, either bullets, electricity, ultraviolet wave or sonic mines.
	From now on, a darker shade will represent the damage done by bullets and the ultraviolet wave on the organism.

2- An alarm for the urgent situation.
	The heartbeat and bloodstream adjusts themselves as the organism's health lowers, however, if this value reaches 10% or less, a cardiograph sound will trigger to alert the player of the serious situation.

3- A transition effect between game scenes.
	Between the game levels or navigating between game scenes, a smooth transition polishes the game navigation.

4- A blinking animation for the selector frame.
	A more visual selection frame for ease of navigation in the option scene. 

5- New option to diminish the red blood cells count.
	If you wish to play with the anemia blood composition, this option is now available and will reduce considerably the number of red blood cells in the background. 




This sums it up for now, as always, I thank you for your support and enjoy the game.

notes.title: Update 1.21 - Bloodstream
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Since I wanted the game's fantasy to be based (at a certain ratio) on reality and facts of the human body or biology in general, I can confess the blood composition was completely out of my alignment.  I had difficulty getting it to work to be fair and let mostly the smaller parts (platelets) to be floating around at the heartbeat rhythm.

But the blood composition is mostly of plasma 55%, red blood cells 41% and roughly 4% of white blood cells and platelets.

So today, the minor update will prove to be a major immersion for the players as the new blood composition of the game gets a far more satisfying appearance.  

I hope you enjoy it.


There are also some minor tweaks to the game related to the balance of play/perks/unlocks listed below :

1-Diminishment of the amount of damage the Tetani bacteria generates to the organism by its presence from 0.02 to 0.01. Better chances to reach further levels and unlock special achievements in the future.

2-Diminishment of the DEL light strength from Nanobot to prevent a blast of red colors from the new parallax background.

3-Adjustments to the positive and negative emotion icons created by Nanobot's DEL light with the new parallax background.

4-Bait no longer attract the Botulinum bacteria. The player must now rely on other means or white cells defense.

5-Chances of spawning other enemies is now 20% instead of 15%. 

6-Number of Special molecules, spawning from the hidden glands in the level are now within a range of  1 to 3.


Thank you for your support and enjoy the game :)

notes.title: Nano major update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thought there are no steam achievements or leader board for now, Steam API is the basis to many good features.

So I worked heavily last week on some nice features to get the version of the game to 1.20 : Steam API, the remote play together feature, and the "organarium" :)

What does it mean, from beta 1.10b to 1.20b ?

1- Steam API provides a lot more functions to get the most out of the game. Many of them will be used in the future.

2- The remote play together from the steam API is stable and a great addition to the game.  You can now invite your family or friend to play with you in a virtual local mode. Simply start your game, set the option to 2x nanobots (coop) and invite your friend from your Steam friend's list for a remote play session.  

3- I also wanted a new scoring method beside the % efficiency, so today, a new "organarium" (Organ + aquarium) is now at the end of the game and presents your final results when your game is "truly" over. (The end of nanobot or organism is in serious danger when its health is at 0%.) I hope you enjoy this new addition until I get to the Steam summit, the "World leader board".

As always, I thank you for playing NA.NO game :)
